## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to this repository's responsibility.
- [ ] Tests or validation cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, unreleased lore, or confidential material are included.
- [ ] Third-party code and assets have documented provenance and compatible terms.
- [ ] Security, licensing, data, accessibility, and creative-IP effects are addressed.
- [ ] Cross-repository dependencies or companion pull requests are linked.
